question: Which Indian language is also recognised as an official language of Singapore and Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamil** is officially recognized in both Singapore and Sri Lanka.
 
• In Singapore, Tamil is one of the four official languages, alongside English, Malay, and Mandarin.
 
• In Sri Lanka, Tamil is one of the two official and national languages, the other being Sinhala.
 
• Tamil has a rich literary tradition and is one of the longest-surviving classical languages in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Tamil language has official status in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu and the Union Territory of Puducherry.
 
• It is also spoken by significant populations in Malaysia, Mauritius, Fiji, and South Africa.
 
• Tamil is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India and was declared a classical language by the Government of India in 2004.
 
• The Tamil script is used to write the Tamil language and is known for its unique and intricate characters.
